content.text: You are looking at orbital images of planetary ground at about 25 to 50 cm per pixel. Image 1 is a square at native resolution centred on an object a detector flagged. Question: is the object at the centre of image 1 more consistent with a piece of manufactured hardware (a metal or fabric object with a crisp outline, a shadow of a raised body, unlike its surroundings) or with a natural feature (a rock, a crater rim, a slope, a ripple crest, a frost or dust pattern)? Answer with the schema: verdict hardware, natural or unsure; confidence 0 to 1; reason, one sentence naming what in the pixels decided it. Say unsure when the pixels do not decide it.
